source_evidence: Completed comparison of all three enlarged retry strips against every printed body line on the hash-pinned Pappus PDF345/printed802. The top block retains the four lines from μείζων ἐστὶν ἡ ΑΔ through εἰ δὴ καὶ τὸ ΔΜΝ. The second strip resumes ποιεῖ τὸ πρόβλημα, retains the complete intervening proof and the Ἵνα δὲ καὶ ἐπιγνῶμεν paragraph opening, and ends ἐν τῇ διωρισμένῃ δέδεικται. The third resumes ἐλάσσον and retains the final line ending ἡ τῶν ἀπὸ ΟΑ ΑΔ. Every body line occurs once in reading order. No diagram block, diagram labels, running header or small apparatus below the rule is included. Printed accents and breathings are represented throughout the retry, whereas the original page had none. Literal OCR errors including γεγράψω, ἤξω, ἀπολούσως, οὖν and a marginal5 read as δ remain unchanged model readings for the independent-model vote. This review confirms source coverage, layout and recovery of printed mark classes; it does not adjudicate every word, substitute the other model, or select readings by a score.
